download_hq_edit_dataset: download the HQ-Edit image editing dataset from HuggingFace to a local data directory
download_hq_edit_force: force re-download the HQ-Edit dataset images and prompts from HuggingFace even if already cached
load_hq_edit_prompts: load HQ-Edit prompts and images into a dictionary mapping IDs to edit instructions and captions
review_download_function: review the download function that fetches HQ-Edit images and prompts from the UCSC-VLAA HuggingFace repo
refactor_load_prompts: refactor the load_prompts function to support custom image filename patterns beyond sequential indexing
